named-query.name: Action.findByUser
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Action a LEFT JOIN FETCH user.picture WHERE a.user = :user ORDER BY a.date DESC

named-query.name: Action.countByUser
named-query.query: SELECT count(a) FROM Action a WHERE a.user = :user

named-query.name: Action.findAll
named-query.query: SELECT a FROM Action a ORDER BY a.date DESC

named-query.name: Action.countAll
named-query.query: SELECT count(a) FROM Action a

named-query.name: Bookmark.findByUrl
named-query.query: SELECT b FROM Bookmark b WHERE b.url = :url

named-query.name: Candidate.findByEmail
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c WHERE c.email = :email

named-query.name: Candidate.findByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c LEFT JOIN c.jobCandidatures jc WHERE jc.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: Candidate.findAllData
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.files LEFT JOIN FETCH c.tags LEFT JOIN FETCH c.owner LEFT JOIN c.curriculum WHERE c.id = :candidateId

named-query.name: Contact.findByEmail
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Contact c WHERE c.email = :email

named-query.name: Contact.findByClient
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Contact c WHERE c.client = :client

named-query.name: Contact.countByClient
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(c) FROM Contact c WHERE c.client = :client

named-query.name: Client.findAllData
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Client c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobOffers LEFT JOIN FETCH c.contacts LEFT JOIN FETCH c.owner WHERE c.id = :clientId

named-query.name: Curriculum.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Curriculum c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.education LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobExperiences LEFT JOIN FETCH c.languages LEFT JOIN FETCH c.skills WHERE c.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: Curriculum.Skill.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT s FROM Skill s WHERE s.name = :name

named-query.name: DocumentTemplate.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT d FROM DocumentTemplate d WHERE d.name = :name

named-query.name: DocumentTemplate.findByNameAndLanguage
named-query.query: SELECT d FROM DocumentTemplate d WHERE d.name = :name AND d.language = :language

named-query.name: File.findByHashAndBucket
named-query.query: SELECT f FROM PhysicalFile f WHERE f.contentHash = :hash AND f.bucket = :bucket

named-query.name: File.isOrphanPhysicalFile
named-query.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(f) > 0) THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END FROM File f WHERE f.physicalFile = :physicalFile

named-query.name: JobCandidatureEvent.findAllByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidatureEvent j WHERE j.jobCandidature.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobCandidatureEvent.countAllByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobCandidatureEvent j WHERE j.jobCandidature.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findApprovedByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer AND j.state.approved = TRUE

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByJobOfferAndCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer AND j.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.candidate LEFT JOIN j.candidate.curriculum LEFT JOIN FETCH j.state WHERE j.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByUser
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j WHERE :user MEMBER OF j.jobOffer.recruiters OR j.jobOffer.owner = :user

named-query.name: JobCandidatureState.findFirstJobCandidatureState
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidatureState j WHERE j.first = true

named-query.name: JobCandidatureState.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidatureState j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.nextStates WHERE j.name = :name

named-query.name: JobOffer.findJobOfferData
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.recruiters LEFT JOIN FETCH j.owner WHERE j.id = :id

named-query.name: JobOffer.findJobOffersByOwnerOrRecruiter
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.client LEFT JOIN FETCH j.owner LEFT JOIN FETCH j.owner.picture WHERE :user MEMBER OF j.recruiters OR j.owner = :user

named-query.name: JobOffer.countJobOffersByOwnerOrRecruiter
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobOffer j WHERE :user MEMBER OF j.recruiters OR j.owner = :user

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j INNER JOIN j.jobCandidatures jc WHERE jc.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByClient
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.owner LEFT JOIN FETCH j.client WHERE j.client = :client

named-query.name: JobOffer.countByClient
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.client = :client

named-query.name: JobOffer.findJobOfferEventsByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOfferEvent j WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobOffer.countJobOfferEventsByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT COUNT(j) FROM JobOfferEvent j WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: Meeting.findByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE m.jobOffer = :jobOffer ORDER BY m.datePlanned ASC

named-query.name: Meeting.findPlannedByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE m.owner = :owner AND m.datePlanned >= :now ORDER BY m.datePlanned ASC

named-query.name: Meeting.findConductedByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE m.owner = :owner AND m.datePlanned < current_date ORDER BY m.datePlanned ASC

named-query.name: Meeting.findByAttendeesEmail
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m LEFT JOIN FETCH m.owner WHERE m.datePlanned < current_date AND :email MEMBER OF m.attendeesEmails ORDER BY m.datePlanned ASC

named-query.name: Rating.findAllData
named-query.query: SELECT r FROM Rating r LEFT JOIN FETCH r.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH r.user WHERE r.id = :ratingId

named-query.name: Rating.findByUser
named-query.query: SELECT r FROM Rating r LEFT JOIN FETCH r.candidate WHERE r.user = :user

named-query.name: Rating.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT r FROM Rating r LEFT JOIN FETCH r.user WHERE r.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: Rating.findRatingOfCandidateByUser
named-query.query: SELECT r FROM Rating r LEFT JOIN r.user u WHERE r.candidate = :candidate AND u = :user

named-query.name: Tag.findByLabel
named-query.query: SELECT t FROM Tag t WHERE t.label = :label

named-query.name: User.findSubordinateUsers
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM UserClosure uc JOIN uc.descendant u WHERE uc.antecessor = :user AND uc.pathLength > 0

named-query.name: User.isSubordinateUser
named-query.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(u) > 0) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM UserClosure uc JOIN uc.descendant u WHERE uc.antecessor = :manager AND u = :subordinate

named-query.name: User.findByEmail
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.bookmarks WHERE u.email = :email

named-query.name: User.findAllData
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.team WHERE u.id = :userId

named-query.name: UserClosure.findAntecessorsUserClosures
named-query.query: SELECT uc FROM UserClosure uc WHERE uc.descendant = :user
